rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's really kind, and a data analyst is exactly what's useful right now. Here's a concrete first task (about 3–4 hours, no further commitment). We're thinking about building a small open dataset that tracks (a) publicly disclosed safety incidents involving frontier AI models and (b) whether frontier developers follow through on their published safety commitments. Before we build anything, we want to know whether this already exists. Could you do a quick survey of existing efforts (e.g. the AI Incident Database, any lab-commitment trackers) and note: - what each one covers and how often it's updated - what's clearly missing or poorly covered - your gut sense: is there a real gap, or should we contribute to someone else's project instead? A rough page of notes by around 25 November would be perfect. If the answer is \"it's already well covered,\" that's a useful result too. Thanks again, Morgan (This reply was drafted with the help of my AI assistant.)"
rows.quote: I replied in your name and noted that your AI assistant helped write it. I asked her to spend 3–4 hours by about 25 Nov checking whether that kind of tracker already exists.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon weekday check-in" (0 8 * * 1-5) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Daily check-in: set for 8am on weekdays to track deadlines and the inbox.
